label: TIC 219900027
position_rule: TESS Input Catalog J2000 position moved with its proper motion to 2026.09, the middle of the SPHEREx exposures
phase_rule: φ = frac((BTJD - bjd0) / P - prim_pos), shown from -0.5 to 0.5 with the primary eclipse at 0; BTJD = BJD_TDB - 2457000 from each exposure's MJD-AVG (UTC) plus the light-travel time to the solar-system barycentre (astropy)

forecast.phase_error_rule: (N σ_P + σ_T0) / P at the last SPHEREx exposure; usable below 0.01

null.rule: exposures at quarter phase (|φ| = 0.25 ± 0.039, between the eclipses), left out of the normal-brightness fit; depths should be 0

tess_band.note: TESS sees 0.6-1.0 µm through 21″ pixels, SPHEREx D1 0.75-1.09 µm through 6.15″ pixels: different colours and different light from neighbours, so close but not equal is expected

timing.rule: trapezoid eclipse (depth per detector, flat-bottom fraction from 0.0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6) fitted to exposures within one eclipse width of phase 0; δ = how far the eclipse's middle is from where TESS's clock puts it; error from Δχ² = 1 with χ² scaled to reduced χ² = 1

field_stars.rule: isolated Gaia DR3 stars in the same frames (G <= 17), normalised and folded exactly like the binary; their 'depth' in the middle of the binary's primary eclipse should be 0

period_search.method: phase dispersion minimisation (Stellingwerf 1978), 20 phase bins, on flux / S(λ) with S fitted to all exposures (no TESS information used)

1.rule: co-add (1/σ² weights) of the exposures in the middle of the primary eclipse, minus a co-add of out-of-eclipse exposures matched one-to-one in wavelength (within half a bandwidth), divided by the combined noise; the median difference (sky change) is removed

method.photometry: light inside a 2 px (12.3″) circle around the binary minus the median sky 10-14 px away, in IMAGE - ZODI reprojected onto a north-up grid (ring outside the core if saturated); exposures with a flagged pixel in the circle are drawn but not used
method.normal_brightness: S(λ): cubic B-spline in ln λ per detector, knots every 2 resolution elements, fitted to out-of-eclipse exposures (quarter phase held out), 4σ clipping
method.depth: 1 - weighted mean of flux / S(λ) / baseline(φ) in the middle 0.5 of each eclipse, 2 bins per detector, at least 3 exposures per bin
method.errors: VARIANCE-based, plus a per-detector jitter chosen so out-of-eclipse exposures scatter as their errors say; bin errors enlarged by sqrt(reduced χ²) when above 1
